text: After escaping Raccoon City, Leon Kennedy was detained by the United States government due to his survival skills and knowledge of the T-virus outbreak.
The government gave Leon Kennedy a choice: become a covert federal agent, or Sherry Birkin would remain in indefinite government custody.
Leon Kennedy signed away his personal freedom and entered federal service to protect Sherry Birkin.
Leon Kennedy underwent years of tactical and psychological training under the Division of Security Operations, transforming him from a rookie cop into an elite agent.
Leon Kennedy began reporting directly to the U.S. President's secret service, handling missions related to bioterrorism and international security.
By 2004, Leon Kennedy was sent to a remote Spanish valley for his highest-stakes mission yet.
Centuries ago, the first Castellan of the Salazar family stripped Los Illuminados of its regional power and entombed the Las Plagas parasites to prevent their use.
Los Illuminados remained dormant for generations until a charismatic outsider infiltrated the cult's religious hierarchy in the late 20th century.
The outsider who infiltrated Los Illuminados promised the cult a return to its former glory and began an excavation to unearth the fossilized Las Plagas.
Osmund Saddler's team successfully revived the prehistoric Las Plagas organisms after unearthing the fossilized parasites.
Osmund Saddler's ultimate plan was to kidnap Ashley Graham, infect her with a Plaga, and return her to the U.S. as a supposedly rescued victim.
Osmund Saddler manipulated Ramon Salazar by claiming the first Castellan had been a tyrant who denied the people their true spiritual heritage.
Ramon Salazar broke the ancestral seal, allowing Los Illuminados to harvest Las Plagas from the subterranean mines.
After Umbrella's collapse, Luis Sera returned home and was hired by Osmund Saddler to analyze the unearthed Plagas and refine the strains.
Luis Sera betrayed Los Illuminados after learning Osmund Saddler planned mass global infection, stealing a pristine dominant Plaga sample and technical removal data.
Jack Krauser was a decorated soldier and Leon Kennedy's former partner during Operation Javier in 2002.
After a career-ending arm injury, Jack Krauser faked his death and sought Albert Wesker to gain enhanced power.
Albert Wesker sent Jack Krauser to infiltrate Los Illuminados as a secret operative.
Jack Krauser's mission was to retrieve a dominant Plaga sample for Wesker's organization, and he orchestrated Ashley Graham's kidnapping to prove his loyalty to Osmund Saddler.
Ada Wong was monitored by Albert Wesker via satellite throughout her mission in Spain.
Leon Kennedy arrived in the remote Spanish valley escorted by two local police officers at the start of his mission.
The first villager Leon Kennedy encountered attacked him with a hatchet, showing glazed eyes and immunity to pain, revealing that the region's peace was false.
Leon Kennedy's two police escorts were murdered by the local population and their vehicle pushed into a canyon, leaving him isolated.
In the village square, Leon Kennedy witnessed one of his escorts burned at a stake before the Ganados swarmed him with pitchforks, sickles, and chainsaws.
Defeating Del Lago cleared the path toward the castle ruins for Leon Kennedy.

After the Del Lago battle, Leon Kennedy encountered a mysterious figure in red at the castle who turned out to be Ada Wong, six years after he believed she died in the Raccoon City sewers/nest facility.
Leon Kennedy found Luis Sera bound in a sack inside a rural farmhouse during his village investigation.
Bitores Mendez knocked Leon Kennedy unconscious before Leon and Luis Sera could talk, chaining them together for execution by the Ganados.
Leon Kennedy and Luis Sera coordinated to break free from their restraints, after which Luis fled into the woods carrying medical equipment designed to suppress parasitic growth.
Leon Kennedy rescued Ashley Graham from confinement inside the village church.
Osmund Saddler appeared on a balcony in the church and revealed his plot to infect the highest levels of the American government using Ashley Graham.
Osmund Saddler revealed that both Leon Kennedy and Ashley Graham had already been injected with Plaga eggs while unconscious.
Before the church rescue, Bitores Mendez cornered Leon Kennedy in an isolated cabin and overpowered him by lifting him by the throat.
Bitores Mendez recognized the Plaga larva already bonding with Leon Kennedy's nervous system and chose to spare him, viewing him as a future brother in the cult.
Leon Kennedy and Ashley Graham were ambushed by Colmillos while navigating dark forest trails.
Leon Kennedy fought El Gigante in a quarry to reach the castle gates.
Bitores Mendez's death marked the transition point from the village section of the story into the castle investigation.
Ramon Salazar used local laborers and cult zealots to excavate the petrified remains of ancient parasites beneath the castle.
While exploring the castle's ritual chambers, Ashley Graham fell into a hidden wall trap set by Ramon Salazar and was separated from Leon Kennedy.
Before Luis Sera could deliver the sample and blueprints to Leon Kennedy, Jack Krauser ambushed him in a ritual chamber and fatally stabbed him through the chest.
Generations of local miners were forced by the Salazar family to excavate petrified Las Plagas remains preserved in low-oxygen amber deposits.
Krauser's journals detailed his psychological breakdown following Operation Javier in 2002, where he first witnessed the power of Las Plagas.
Ada Wong was captured in an industrial chamber equipped with high-voltage equipment and vertical spaces used by the cult to trap her.
Leon Kennedy confronted Osmund Saddler at the highest crane platform of the island facility to finalize his mission.
Ada Wong broke free from her containment and provided Leon Kennedy with a special rocket launcher during the final battle.
The destruction of Osmund Saddler's final form ended the leadership of Los Illuminados.
Immediately after Saddler's death, Ada Wong held Leon Kennedy at gunpoint to take the pristine dominant Plaga sample from the remains.
Ada Wong gave Leon Kennedy an apology along with the keys to an aquatic craft before escaping by helicopter.
As she flew away, Ada Wong triggered a thermal self-destruct sequence that destroyed the entire island facility.
Leon Kennedy and Ashley Graham had a strict three-minute window to escape to the shoreline before the island's self-destruct sequence completed.
Leon Kennedy used an aquatic craft to bypass final security locks and escape the collapsing island facility with Ashley Graham.
The island facility was completely destroyed, erasing evidence of Los Illuminados' operations.
